purpose: Strengthen naturalistic activation evidence with a bounded chronological restart probe while preserving the Class-A accounting-only scope.

source_bound_restart_capability.final_state_writer: Output_Init.for writes Rsex into >orgexu: of INITIAL.OUT
source_bound_restart_capability.hydrology_subperiod_support: input1.for can position SWATRE.UNF to an ANIMO start date inside the hydrology period

probe_design.segment_A: Run frozen diagnostic CranMais from original start to a selected accepted chronological boundary and capture model-produced INITIAL.OUT.
probe_design.segment_B: Start a second execution at that chronological boundary using segment-A INITIAL.OUT as INITIAL.INP and the same frozen hydrology stream positioned to the new start date.
probe_design.comparison: Evaluate only the TCD-026 restart-state and beginning-ledger identity surfaces required for Class-A readiness; do not infer whole-model split-run identity unless independently proven.

required_checks: Segment-A generated INITIAL.OUT contains nonzero model-produced Ex/Rsex.
Segment-B reads the model-produced >orgexu: values without manual Ex synthesis.
Legacy segment-B first fresh-OM balance residual matches the omitted beginning Ex mass subject only to report-format rounding.
Ledger-only candidate removes that deterministic residual without changing restart state or ordinary state/process outputs.
No physical source, testcase, initialization physics, production migration, corrected-legacy admission or other organic-matter TCD is modified.
explicit_nonclaims: This plan does not predeclare a full continuous-vs-split trajectory identity qualification.
This plan does not qualify management continuation completeness.
This plan does not create B2 historical-reference evidence.
This plan does not constitute independent second-line review.
